role: v18 COMPLETION — two sampler-provenance items + one free ground-truth check, sealed BEFORE P3. v18 is committed (3e6e0c2); per the standing mechanic (don't rewrite sealed preregs) these ride as v19, which completes v18's item_2.
extends: v18 (P3 sampler discipline) and v17 (qualified observable = corr).

item_1_exact_vs_sampled_provenance_per_c.rule: EVERY P3 ξ measurement carries a boolean `exact`: an instance with solution_count <= K is an ENUMERATION, not a sample — it carries ZERO sampling error. This is a provenance distinction as real as derived-vs-measured in the atlas, and it changes how the cell is READ.
item_1_exact_vs_sampled_provenance_per_c.consequence: exact cells need NO concordance check (there is no sampling to concord); sampled cells (solution_count > K) DO. The findings state coverage per epistemic situation — exact vs sampled — NOT one uniform caveat across both.
item_1_exact_vs_sampled_provenance_per_c.reported: per family × size: the `exact` flag, the solution_count, and K, so the exact/sampled split is auditable. Aggregate: fraction of cells exact vs sampled, per family.

item_2_concordance_is_a_GATE_with_a_floo.the_problem_it_closes: 'P3 exercises concordance at genuine-subsampling sizes' as an aspiration lets the sweep run entirely in the small-instance (exact) regime, and we would rediscover the P2 vacuity at P4. So it is a GATE with a stated floor.
item_2_concordance_is_a_GATE_with_a_floo.materially_exceeds_K: solution_count >= 4*K (the sampler sees <= 25% of solutions) — the bar for 'genuine subsampling'.
item_2_concordance_is_a_GATE_with_a_floo.floor: at least M_MIN = 5 distinct families must have >= 1 genuinely-subsampled measurement (solution_count >= 4*K). At every such subsampled measurement, the dpll-vs-walksat reach_score |Δ| is recorded.
item_2_concordance_is_a_GATE_with_a_floo.delta_threshold: the sampler-robustness discipline PASSES iff (>= 5 families subsampled) AND (median |Δ_dpll_walksat| <= 0.10 across all subsampled measurements AND 90th-percentile <= 0.20).

outcomes_pre_labelled.verified: >=5 families subsampled and Δ within threshold -> sampled cells' sampler-robustness guard is VERIFIED.
outcomes_pre_labelled.untested: <5 families reach the subsampling regime -> the guard is UNVERIFIED; every sampled cell is FLAGGED unverified-guard in the findings (not silently trusted).
outcomes_pre_labelled.discordant: Δ exceeds threshold -> a sampler artifact is present on the real observable; investigate before P4 uses the sampled cells.

item_3_boundary_ground_truth_bias_free.insight: at sizes where enumeration is feasible, ξ has GROUND TRUTH available, so the sampled-vs-exact comparison at the BOUNDARY (instances with K < solution_count <= the enumeration ceiling) is a FREE, DIRECT measurement of sampler bias ON THE REAL OBSERVABLE and the ACTUAL ROSTER — strictly better than the affine-exact check (one special family, and vacuous when enumerated), which it REPLACES as the primary sampler-bias check.
item_3_boundary_ground_truth_bias_free.operation: P3 enumerates solutions exactly whenever n <= ENUM_N_MAX = 20 (brute force over 2^n is feasible). At such instances: if solution_count <= K the cell is EXACT (sampler trivially enumerates; bias 0 by definition). If solution_count > K the sampler genuinely subsamples, and bias = |ξ_sampled(corr) − ξ_exact(corr)| on that instance is a direct roster-real sampler-bias datum.
item_3_boundary_ground_truth_bias_free.reported: per family, the distribution of boundary biases where available; this is the PRIMARY sampler-bias check. The old affine-exact check is retained only as a secondary, and only where it is non-vacuous (affine instance with solution_count > K).
item_3_boundary_ground_truth_bias_free.enumeration_ceiling: n <= 20 -> brute-force enumerate (2^20 assignments, feasible). n > 20 -> purely sampled; those cells rely on the item-2 concordance gate for their guard.

standing_discipline: per-cell exact/sampled boolean; concordance claimed only on sampled cells
concordance is a GATE: >=5 families at solution_count>=4K, median Δ<=0.10 (else sampled cells flagged unverified)
boundary exact-vs-sampled bias (n<=20, sols>K) is the primary sampler-bias check, on the real roster
findings state coverage per epistemic situation (exact vs sampled), not one uniform caveat
